---
title: Projects
subtitle: Beyond the professional scope
---

The projects I build are an expression of my values and a source of fulfillment. Explore some of the work I’ve been building in my personal time.

## Color Clock

Tell time with color. An immersive art installation and engineering milestone that transforms the abstract passage of time into a tangible spectrum of light. A decade-long journey from initial concept to final deployment. Developed in C++ using the Arduino Command Line Interface.

## The Book of Plans

A paper-based system for personal growth, providing the structure needed to align your daily actions with your long-term identity. Developed in Python using the svgwrite library.

## Color Scheme Exporter

A utility for generating consistent color schemes across various terminal emulators, designed to bring a unified aesthetic and creative joy to your development environment. Developed in Python.

## rebeccajennifer.com

A digital home for my projects and resources. An open notebook for my technical work and a collection of notes for my future self that I hope others find useful, too. Developed with the Quarto publishing framework.
